snippet.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Ocean Adventure (3D Racing) | Gameplay [Smart Cycle (2007)]
snippet.description:
Playthrough/gameplay of the Fisher-Price Smart Cycle (2007) game "SpongeBob SquarePants: Ocean Adventure". This particular version of the game is the 2012 re-release which features an all new 3D racing game.

Note: my particular Smart Cycle experiences an issue where the joystick isn't registered when moved to the up position. Although not game breaking, this issue can be seen occurring throughout the video.
